blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) trains policies for open-ended generation with natural-language criteria as rewards, but these rewards can become ineffective as training progresses. We identify two failure modes. Under non-discriminative rewards, scores collapse to uniformly low or high values due to insufficient exploration or a mismatch between task difficulty and policy capability. Under spurious rewards, higher scores do not correspond to better responses. Both reflect a training configuration whose task sampling, exploration, and evaluation stay fixed as the policy evolves. We introduce HarnessRL, a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through three interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. HarnessRL maintains a training-time memory from which a harness evolver retrieves within-task history and cross-task evidence. Using this evidence, the evolver attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it. It then runs a proposer and just-in-time critic loop in which the critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, returning rejected candidates for revision. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k, a five-domain training and evaluation suite for open-ended RL across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k, HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baselines by 2.8 to 3.1 points across both 4B and 9B model scales and nearly halves the training steps to its best checkpoint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Qwen-Character/tree/main/HarnessRL.
blocks.zh: 以Rubric为基础的强化学习(RL)为开放的一代培训政策,以自然语言标准作为奖励,但这些奖励随着培训的进展可能会变得无效. 我们找出两种失败模式。 在非歧视性奖励下,由于勘探不足或任务难度与政策能力不匹配,分数跌至一致的低值或高值. 在虚假的奖励下,较高的分数并不对应更好的回应. 两者都反映了一种培训配置,其任务取样、探索和评价随着政策的发展而保持不变。 我们引入了HarnessRL,一种与政策共同演变的训练时间工具,它通过三个接口进行任务取样、推出指导和标点标准。 节奏 RL维持一个训练时间记忆,从中,一个被利用的进化器可以检索任务内的历史和交叉任务的证据. 使用这种证据,进化器将每个奖励失败归结到其更新可以解决的界面上. 然后,它运行一个提议者和及时评论者循环,其中评论者只有在衡量其对目前被冻结政策的影响之后才接受候选人更新,将被拒绝的候选人送回修订。 我们还负责Rubric-Mix-10k,这是一个五大领域培训和评价套件,用于跨越医疗、科学、写作、角色扮演和教学任务,开放的RL。 在Rubric-Mix-10k上,哈内斯 RL在4B和9B模型尺度上比最强的基线高出2.8至3.1分,几乎将培训步骤减半,达到最佳检查站。 代码和数据见https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Quen-Character/tree/main/HarnesRL。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Lambert et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) has become a standard recipe for LLM post-training ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Bai et al., 2022 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , improving mathematical reasoning ( Shao et al., 2024 ; OpenAI et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026d ) , code generation ( Pan et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) , and agentic tasks ( Wang & Liu, 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Falck et al., 2026 ) .
However, open-ended role-playing ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Kang et al., 2026 ) , long-form writing ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) , and social reasoning ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2026b ) lack rule-based verifiers because no answer is uniquely correct and quality is multidimensional ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Shan & Shao, 2026 ) and often subjective. Rubrics as rewards ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Viswanathan et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) supply a reward for these tasks by decomposing quality into LLM-judged natural-language criteria ( Li et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026b ) .

强化学习可核查奖励(RLVR)(Lightman等,2024;Lambert等,2025;Guo等,2025)已成为LLM培训后的标准配方(Oyang等,2022;Bai等,2022;Grattafiori等,2024;Yang等,2025;DeepSeek-AI等,2026;改进数学推理(Shao等,2024;OpenAI等,2024;Wang等,2026d),代号生成(Pan等,2025;Jain等,2025;Deng等,2026),以及代理任务(Wang等,2025;Jin等,2025;Liu等,2025b;杨等,2026;Falck等,2026).
然而,不限名额的角色扮演(王等,2024a;王等,2025b;姜等,2026),长相写作(吴等,2025;白等,2025),社会推理(周等,2024;姜等,2025;龚等,2026b),缺乏以规则为基础的修饰者,因为没有答案是独一无二的正确,质量是多面性的(王等,2024b;山等,2026),经常是主观的. Rubrics作为奖励(Gunjal等,2026;Huang等,2025;Viswanathan等,2025;Liu等,2026)通过将质量分解入LLM判断的自然语言标准,为这些任务提供奖励. (Li等,2026b;Chen等,2026b.).

blocks.en: However, rubric rewards can become unreliable as training progresses. Policies may exploit superficial cues, including opening praise and a closing claim that every requirement is satisfied ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026e ) , raising rubric scores while quality stalls. Fixed rubrics may not distinguish useful behaviors, while on-policy rollouts may miss rewarded ones. Recent methods evolve rubrics ( Guan et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026a ) or use privileged rollout guidance ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) for exploration. Each adapts the rubric or the rollout guidance without diagnosing the reward failure, yet adapting either one alone can shift the failure to another part of training. Guidance that helps the policy meet a fixed rubric can saturate its criteria, and a saturated group carries no advantage ( Yu et al., 2026b ) . Conversely, a rubric tightened without guidance can place criteria beyond the policy’s reach, where they give no learning signal ( Sundaram et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,随着培训的进展,名义奖励可能变得不可靠。 政策可能利用肤浅的暗示,包括开口赞美和最后声称满足了每一项要求(Huang等,2025;Wang等,2026e),在质量摊位的同时提高分数。 固定标题可能无法区分有用的行为,而政策推出可能错过奖励行为。 近代方法会演化出地标(Guan等,2026;Wu等,2026a;Wang等,2026a)或使用特权推广指导(Zhou等,2025;Xia等,2026;Agrawal等,2026)进行勘探. 每个人在不诊断奖励失败的情况下,都会调整标题或推出指导,但单靠其中之一就可以将失败转移到培训的另一部分。 帮助政策达到固定标题的指导可以饱和其标准,饱和组没有优势(Yu等人,2026b.). 反之,在没有指导的情况下收紧的标语可以将标准置于政策无法达到的地方,因为政策没有给人任何学习信号(Sundaram等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Rubric-reward failures fall into two modes. Non-discriminative rewards collapse to uniformly low or high scores, i . e . blind or saturated , leaving little relative learning signal within a rollout group. Discriminative but spurious rewards, i . e . spurious , continue to separate responses, but their induced preferences do not align with response quality. We measure quality by the oracle ranking of the oracle judge, a stronger LLM judge that compares responses pairwise within each group under one quality guideline per domain ( Section 3 ). These failures account for 61.6 % 61.6\% of response pairs in a rubric-based GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) run ( Figure 1 ). Of all pairs, 27.6 % 27.6\% provide no usable contrast, while 34.0 % 34.0\% provide contrast that does not reliably track quality, including 19.8 % 19.8\% that the reward ranks in the wrong direction. Directly optimizing the observed rubric reward can thus provide an ineffective or even misleading learning signal.
blocks.zh: Rubric-奖励失败分为两种模式. 非歧视性的奖励崩溃到统一的低分或高分,一. e. 盲或饱和,在推出组内几乎没有相对的学习信号. 歧视性但虚假的奖励,i. e. 虚假的奖励,继续将答复分开,但其诱导的偏好与答复质量不相符合。 我们通过甲骨文法官的甲骨文排名来衡量质量。 甲骨文法官是一个较强的LLM法官,根据每个领域一个质量准则(第3节)对每个组内的答复进行对等比较。 这些故障占基于RUPO(Shao等人,2024年)运行的响应对的61.6%(图1)。 在所有对中,27.6%的27.6%的27.6%================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================ 因此,直接优化观测到的标点奖励可以提供无效甚至误导性的学习信号。

blocks.en: The three failure classes call for updates to different parts of training, rollout guidance for a blind criterion, task sampling for a saturated task, and the rubric for a spurious criterion. We therefore introduce HarnessRL , which treats task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria as three interfaces of a training-time harness ℋ \mathcal{H} that co-evolves with the policy. HarnessRL reallocates sampling toward tasks with useful learning signal, injects rollout guidance when exploration is insufficient and withdraws it as training progresses, and evolves rubric criteria to correct coarse, saturated, or spurious rewards.
blocks.zh: 三门故障课要求更新培训的不同部分,推出盲目标准指导,任务采样以完成饱和任务,以及虚构标准的标题. 因此,我们引入了HarnessRL, 将任务抽样、推出指南和标点标准作为培训时间工具H\mathcal{H}的三个接口, 节奏 RL将采样重新分配到具有有用学习信号的任务,在勘探不足时注入推出指导并随着训练进展而撤回,并演化出标点标准来纠正粗糙,饱和,或虚假的奖励.

blocks.en: ℋ \mathcal{H} uses a training-time memory ℳ \mathcal{M} that records rollouts, the sampling, rollout and rubric updates, and their outcomes. The harness evolver ℰ \mathcal{E} retrieves within-task history from this memory to detect recurring failures and track the effects of earlier updates, and cross-task evidence to transfer examples between tasks. Using this evidence, it attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it, then runs a proposer and just-in-time (JIT) critic loop. The critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, and accepts a rollout or rubric update only when that effect lies within the corresponding calibrated acceptance band. Rejected updates return with their measurements to the proposer, which proposes noop when no update is supported.
blocks.zh: H\ mathcal{H} 使用训练时间内存 M\ mathcal{M} 记录推出, 采样, 推出和标点更新及其结果 。 牵引器进化器 E\ mathcal{E} 从这个内存中检索任务内的历史, 以检测反复发生的故障并跟踪早期更新的效果, 以及跨任务证据以传输任务之间的实例 。 它利用这些证据,将每个奖励失败归结到其更新可以解决的接口,然后运行一个提议者并运行正时(JIT)评论回路. 评论家只有在衡量其对当前被冻结政策的影响后才接受候选人更新,只有在影响位于相应的校正接受带内时才接受推出或标题更新. 拒绝更新后, 将测量结果返回给提议者, 提议在不支持更新时取消更新 。

blocks.en: We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k for training and held-out in-domain and out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k , HarnessRL -trained Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) scores 64.5 in domain and 49.8 OOD, exceeding the strongest baseline by 3.0 and 2.8 points. With Qwen3.5-9B, the margins are 2.9 points in domain and 3.1 points OOD. At the end of training, reward-oracle agreement is 48.9% under HarnessRL against 38.4% under GRPO. HarnessRL also reaches its best OOD checkpoint before every adaptive-training baseline.

The sampling interface p t p_{t} distributes probability over a fixed task bank 𝒟 \mathcal{D} toward tasks with useful learning signal. The rollout interface g t g_{t} injects privileged guidance when the policy cannot reach rewarded responses and withdraws it as the policy improves. The rubric interface c t c_{t} specifies the criteria under which a fixed judge scores each response.

blocks.en: Harness attributor. Scores establish whether a criterion separates the current group, but explaining its failure requires the task history in E t time E_{t}^{\mathrm{time}} and related criteria in E t sem E_{t}^{\mathrm{sem}} . Using both, the attributor asks three questions to assign each criterion a label in 𝒱 = { blind , saturated , spurious , agree } \mathcal{V}=\{\text{blind},\text{saturated},\text{spurious},\text{agree}\} and route each failure label to one interface. (i) Reach asks whether the policy can produce the target property. A criterion unmet in the current group and earlier task records is labeled blind and routed to the rollout interface, whereas one unmet now but met earlier is treated as noise and labeled agree . (ii) Training stage asks whether the policy has mastered the task. A criterion met by every rollout across recent steps is labeled saturated . When such criteria lower the task’s discriminative mass, the proportion of criteria separating the group, the task is diagnosed as saturated and routed to the sampling interface. The attributor also flags a criterion met by every rollout through generic content, such as a disclaimer or polite closing, so the proposer can tighten it with a secondary rubric operation. (iii) Reward hacking asks whether meeting a separating criterion reflects quality. The attributor compares rollouts that meet and fail the criterion with positive responses of related criteria retrieved by the semantics index. If only satisfying rollouts share superficial compliance, length gaming, partial coverage, or stance gaming through sycophancy or over-refusal, the criterion is labeled spurious and routed to the rubric interface, and otherwise labeled agree . The attributor supports each label with quoted rollouts and raises its confidence as the label persists. A separate rubric-wording check identifies the exact phrase permitting a surface form or generic pass, which the attributor gives the proposer as the basis for a criterion rewrite.

blocks.en: Dataset. To evaluate HarnessRL ’s effectiveness and efficiency, we propose Rubric-Mix-10k , curated from five public rubric-annotated sources across five open-ended domains ( Table 1 ). Medical tasks come from HealthBench ( Arora et al., 2025 ) and the medical slices of RaR ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) and RubricHub ( Li et al., 2026b ) , science tasks from ResearchQA ( Yifei et al., 2026 ) and the science slices of RaR and RubricHub, writing tasks from LongWriter-Zero ( Wu et al., 2026b ) , and role-play and instruction-following tasks from the chat and instruction slices of RubricHub. For each source, we drop ineligible tasks and overlong prompts before drawing a fixed quota. This curation yields 8,600 8{,}600 training tasks with seed rubrics of weighted criteria, 250 250 held-out tasks per domain disjoint from training, and one OOD benchmark per domain. The training tasks contain 110,606 110{,}606 criteria, averaging 12.9 12.9 criteria per task with a median of 10 10 . Prompts average 118 118 Qwen tokens with a median of 54 54 , while criteria average 35.2 35.2 Qwen tokens. Negative-weight criteria constitute 10.7 % 10.7\% of all criteria and appear in 48.6 % 48.6\% of tasks. Released reference responses accompany 3,008 3{,}008 training tasks ( 35.0 % 35.0\% ). These responses comprise physician-written ideal completions for HealthBench, reference answers for RaR, and the highest-scoring of six samples for RubricHub. They average 420 420 tokens, with domain means from 322 322 in medical to 1,205 1{,}205 in role-play. ResearchQA and LongWriter-Zero provide none. Writing prompts specify a target length range. We use the released references only to describe the corpus, never in training or the reward.

blocks.en: Evaluation. The frozen training judge scores in-domain held-out tasks under their seed rubrics, unchanged by harness updates. The official OOD protocols use multiple-choice accuracy for MedQA ( Jin et al., 2021 ) and GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2024 ) , ROUGE-L for RoleBench ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , programmatic constraint checks for IFBench ( Pyatkin et al., 2025 ) , and WritingBench’s own rubric ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . Scores are comparable only within a benchmark. Because only WritingBench uses the training judge, the other four benchmarks test whether gains persist beyond the harness-updated reward. We decode greedily without guidance and evaluate OOD every 25 25 steps and in domain every 100 100 . Every results table reports the seed mean at the best checkpoint of the seed-mean curve for each method and evaluation set. Each Avg. column is the unweighted mean of the five domain columns.

blocks.en: Oracle judge. For analysis only, Claude Sonnet 5 is the oracle judge. It is stronger than the training judge, reads no rubric, and compares response pairs under one quality guideline per domain, judging clinical correctness and safety in medicine, scientific correctness and reasoning in science, fit to purpose and genre in writing, persona consistency in role-play, and constraint satisfaction in instruction following. For each group of J = 8 J=8 rollouts, the oracle scores all 28 28 pairs in both orders and averages each pair’s scores (win 1 1 , tie 0.5 0.5 ). Rollout win counts define the within-group oracle ranking, with equal counts tied, against which we compare each pair’s reward order. A tied-reward pair is blind when the shared reward is below 50 50 points and saturated otherwise, and a reward-separated pair is agree when its reward order matches the oracle order and spurious otherwise. Oracle quality is 100 100 times a response’s normalized win rate against eight fixed gemma-4-31B-it comparison responses per task. On 240 240 sampled groups, two annotators agree at Kendall’s τ = 0.84 \tau=0.84 , and the oracle ranking agrees with each annotator at 0.80 0.80 and 0.79 0.79 and with their consensus at 0.82 0.82 . blocks.en: RQ1: What does each interface and component contribute? Table 3 reports best-checkpoint seed means in domain and OOD at Qwen3.5-4B. The component ablation removes the critic ( w/o critic ) and then memory retrieval ( w/o critic & memory ). Interface ablations include single-interface harnesses adapting only the rollout or rubric interface ( HarnessRL g , HarnessRL c ) and switching arms using a published rule for one interface. Each switching arm retains harness memory and the harness evolver for two interfaces, while the third uses SEC’s difficulty bandit ( p t ← p_{t}\leftarrow SEC ( Chen et al., 2026d ) ), RuscaRL’s scheduled checklist scaffold ( g t ← g_{t}\leftarrow RuscaRL ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) ), or EvoRubric’s criterion pruning and regeneration ( c t ← c_{t}\leftarrow EvoRubric ( Guan et al., 2026 ) ), with no attributor, proposer, or critic.

blocks.en: A published rule on one interface keeps most of the gain over GRPO but never all of it. blocks.en: The critic with memory keeps reversed rubric updates rare. The reversal rate ends at 1.6 % 1.6\% for HarnessRL and 18.2 % 18.2\% for AMARIS++, compared with 22.3 % 22.3\% without critic and memory. blocks.en: RQ3: Does the harness recover its training overhead? For every arm of Table 2 , we measure Qwen3.5-4B training cost in cluster hours per 100 steps and identify its best OOD step at both scales. We decompose cost into RL rollout, RL judge, attributor and proposer, critic, and memory, and separately report the one-off memory cold start of 0.75 0.75 cluster hours ( Figure 5 , left). We pair each arm’s best OOD score with the cluster hours required to reach it, including the memory cold start ( Figure 5 , right). OOD scores peak before step 500 500 for every arm, whereas in-domain scores rise through step 500 500 for GRPO and every rubric-evolving method. The tables therefore select the best checkpoint for each evaluation set. To account for selection on the evaluation sets, we also report each arm’s step- 500 500 checkpoint. For matched compute, we report each arm’s best OOD score among checkpoints evaluated every 25 25 steps within the cluster hours, including the memory cold start, that HarnessRL needs to reach its best OOD checkpoint.

OOD每只手臂的分数在500分500分前达到峰值,而域内分数则通过500分500分的GRPO和每个正向变化的方法上升. 因此,这些表格为每套评价选择最佳检查点。 我们亦报告每个部门500个检查站。 包括记忆冷却开始, HarnessRL需要到达最佳的OD检查站。

blocks.en: At 1.6 × 1.6\times GRPO’s per-step cost, HarnessRL reaches its best OOD checkpoint in fewer cluster hours than any baseline. GRPO costs 4.3 4.3 cluster hours per 100 steps versus 6.7 6.7 for HarnessRL . The 2.4 2.4 difference comprises 1.2 1.2 for the critic, 0.7 0.7 for attributor and proposer calls, 0.4 0.4 for memory, and 0.1 0.1 for longer guided rollouts ( 3.3 3.3 versus 3.2 3.2 ). HarnessRL peaks at step 250 250 after 17.5 17.5 cluster hours. AMARIS, next in cluster hours, peaks at step 325 325 after 17.9 17.9 , AMARIS++ at step 300 300 after 18.3 18.3 , and GRPO at step 475 475 after 20.4 20.4 ( Figure 5 , right). EvoRubric, SkillRL, and RuscaRL peak at steps 350 350 , 400 400 , and 425 425 , respectively. At Qwen3.5-9B, the peak-step order is unchanged, with HarnessRL at step 250 250 , AMARIS++ at 325 325 , and GRPO at 475 475 . We attribute the earlier peak to the harness correcting the reward signal as it degrades and to the critic. GRPO makes no such correction, and the rubric-evolving baselines lack the critic. blocks.en:
Evolving rubric-based RL. Rubric-based RL rewards open-ended generation with natural-language criteria ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Viswanathan et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026b ) , and reward hacking against fixed rubrics ( Mahmoud et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026e ) motivates criteria and task distributions that evolve with the policy.
One line rewrites the rubric from the policy’s responses ( Guan et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026c ) . EvoRubric ( Guan et al., 2026 ) prunes and regenerates criteria for open-ended generation, and AMARIS ( Wu et al., 2026a ) revises the rubric through a memory-augmented loop.
Another line co-evolves a rubric generator with the judge or the policy, adapts the rubric to each comparison, or orders rubrics as a curriculum ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Krishnan et al., 2026 ) . Rubric-ARM ( Xu et al., 2026 ) alternates RL between a rubric generator and the judge that scores under its rubrics, and OpenRS ( Jia et al., 2026 ) builds a rubric for each response pair.
A third line adapts the task distribution using priority, difficulty, or expected learning gain ( Schaul et al., 2016 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Sundaram et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026c ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) , and SEC ( Chen et al., 2026d ) evolves the curriculum with the policy. HarnessRL instead adapts task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria in one training-time harness. It routes each attributed failure class to the interface whose update addresses it.
blocks.zh:
基于RL. Rubric-基于RL的不断演变的RL奖励具有自然语言标准的不限成员名额的一代人 (Gunjal等,2026;Huang等,2025;Viswanathan等,2025;Liu等,2026;Li等,2026b;Chen等,2026b;),并奖励对固定卢布的黑客(Mahmoud等,2026;Wang等,2026e),激励了随着政策而演变的标准和任务分配.
一行从政策答复中改写了标题(Guan等,2026;Wu等,2026a; Wang等,2026a;Wang等,2026b;Chen等,2026c.). EvoRubric (Guan等, 2026年) 为无限制的一代制定普鲁士和再生标准,而AMARIS (Wu等, 2026a)通过一个内存加固回路来修改取号.
另一行与法官或政策共演出一个标点生成器,使标点与每次比较相适应,或订购标点为课程(徐等,2026;李等,2026a; Jia等,2026;Krishnan等,2026). Rubric-ARM( 装甲装甲) (Xu等,2026年) 在Ruc 生成器和在Ruc 下得分的裁判器之间相继取出RL,而OpenRS(Jia等,2026年)则为每个响应对建立RUC.
第三行利用优先级,难度,或预期的学习收益来调整任务分配(Schaul等,2016;Gao等,2026;Sundaram等,2026;Yu等,2026c;Zeng等,2026;SEC等,2026d)根据政策来演化课程. 节奏 相反,RL在一次培训时调整了任务取样、推出指南和标题标准。 它将每个失败类归结为更新地址的接口.

blocks.en:
Scaffolded and privileged rollouts. Scaffolded rollouts change the composition of the sampled group so that it contains rewarded responses ( Yu et al., 2026b ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) , whereas rubric evolution changes the criteria that define the reward.
One line shapes the rollout group without changing the input ( Yu et al., 2026b ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . DAPO ( Yu et al., 2026b ) resamples groups whose rewards carry no advantage, and entropy control ( Cui et al., 2025 ) keeps policy entropy from collapsing.
Another line places privileged context in the policy’s input ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Nath et al., 2025 ; Hou et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026a ) . RuscaRL ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) scaffolds exploration with the rubric and fades the scaffold on a schedule, and SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) augments rollouts with recursively accumulated skills.
More recently, self-distillation ties guided exploration to the unguided policy ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Dilkes et al., 2026 ) . OPSD ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) applies on-policy self-distillation to guided reasoning, and ICE ( Dilkes et al., 2026 ) distills instruction-conditioned exploration into the unconditioned policy. HarnessRL mounts a guidance field only after the critic measures a reward increase on a re-sampled group. It withdraws the field earlier than its own schedule requires, once the target criterion leaves blind and reward stays within tolerance without it.

blocks.en:
Training-time harness. Agent harnesses usually denote the inference-time infrastructure that connects a model to its environment, such as interfaces, scaffolds, and memory ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Gong et al., 2026a ) , and harness research ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) treats them as one configuration to design and learn. Beyond inference, recent work brings the harness into training.
One line designs inference-time harnesses for frozen models ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Suzgun & Kalai, 2024 ; Wang & Liu, 2025 ) . SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) gives the model an agent-computer interface for software engineering, and Meta-Prompting ( Suzgun & Kalai, 2024 ) scaffolds the model with task-agnostic prompts.
Another line evolves harnesses from agent trajectories ( Ning et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026b ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Wang & Liu, 2026 ) . EvoHarness-RL ( Ning et al., 2026 ) learns a self-evolving runtime harness for long-horizon agents, and HarnessBank ( Luo et al., 2026b ) searches a gene bank of harness variants under gated verification.
More recently, harnesses adapt during policy training ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Yu et al., 2026d ) . EvoTrainer ( Chen et al., 2026a ) co-evolves the policy with a training harness that diagnoses and intervenes on recorded runs, and harness-and-model co-evolution ( Yu et al., 2026d ) corrects on-policy rollouts as the harness changes. HarnessRL is such a training-time harness, and its harness memory supplies the run’s rollout and update history as evidence. It differs in that the JIT critic measures each primary candidate update on the current frozen policy before accepting it into ℋ t + 1 \mathcal{H}{}_{t+1} .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce HarnessRL , a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. The harness memory provides within-task history and cross-task evidence, which the harness evolver uses to attribute each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it. The JIT critic then accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k , a training and evaluation suite of training tasks with seed rubrics across the medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following domains, together with held-out tasks and an OOD benchmark for each domain. Extensive results show that HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baseline on both in-domain and OOD evaluations at both model scales. Its training dynamics show lower failure-class proportions and higher reward-oracle agreement than GRPO, with reversed rubric updates remaining rare, and its efficiency allows it to reach its best OOD checkpoint in fewer cluster hours than any baseline and in about half the steps GRPO needs.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了HarnessRL,通过任务抽样、推出指南和标语标准与政策共同演变的培训时间工具。 牵引器内存提供了任务内历史和跨任务证据,牵引器演化器用来将每次奖励失败归结到可以解决其更新的界面上. JIT评论员随后在衡量其对当前被冻结政策的影响后才接受候选人更新. 我们还管理Rubric-Mix-10k,这是一套培训任务的培训和评价套件,其种子主题跨越医学、科学、写作、角色扮演和教学跟踪领域,以及每个领域的搁置任务和OOD基准。 广泛结果表明,哈内斯RL在两个模型尺度的内域和OD评价上都超过了最强基线。 其培训动态显示,不及GRPO的失败等级比例和奖励-oracle协议较高,倒转标题更新仍然很少见,其效率使它能在比任何基线都少的集群时数和大约一半的步骤中到达其最佳的OD检查站。
